Hakhrazah li-Ymei ha-Hodayah — Announcement for Days of Miraculous Thanksgiving (Purim and Ḥanukkah)

tei:div.tei:head: Hakhrazah li-Ymei ha-Hodayah — Announcement for Days of Miraculous Thanksgiving (Purim and Ḥanukkah)

tei:lg.tei:l: Our siblings, all the house of Israel and all joined with us, listen!
On the (__) day,
and in walled cities on the (__) day,
are the days of Purim,
on which we may not eulogize nor fast.
From (__) day
until (__) day next week
are the eight days of Ḥanukkah,
on which we may not eulogize nor fast.
And just as You worked Your wondrous miracles and many salvations with our ancestors,
so too work with us, o Cause our God, wonder and miracles,
and save us from the hand of antisemites in these days as in those.
As it is written in the words of Your Torah:
“And They said: Behold I cut a covenant with you:
before all Your people, I will work wonders,
such as have never been seen in all the land and in all the nations,
and all the people in which you are will see the work of the Cause,
for awesome is what I will do with you.” (Exodus 34:10)
And in the songs of Your anointed servant it is written, quote:
“You are the wonder-working Deity;
Your might You made known among the peoples.” (Psalms 77:15)
And in the prophecies of Your holy prophets it is written, quote:
“Like the days of your exodus from the land of Egypt,
I wil show him wonders.” (Micah 7:15)
And thus may it be willed,
and we say amen.
